Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JACOB, frail but determined. He is presented with a certificate and a plaque, and the room erupts in applause.

JACOB: (tearfully) Oh, Thank You. I Never Thought I'd See The Day.

The officials and reporters swarm around him, congratulating him on his incredible achievement. Jacob is beaming with pride, his eyes shining with tears.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jacob lies in bed, the certificate and plaque on his nightstand. He looks at them with a mix of emotions, nostalgia and wonder. He takes a deep breath, and begins to speak to himself.

JACOB: (whispering) You Know, I Used To Think I Was Just A Number. A Statistical Anomaly. But Now I'm The Proof. The World Record Holder.

As he speaks, Jacob's eyes glaze over, and he becomes lost in thought. He starts to recall a theory he read on the internet in his youth, "Quantum Immortality".

JACOB: (mumbling to himself) It Said That If You Live Long Enough, You'll Eventually Experience Every Possible Outcome Of Every Decision You've Ever Made. Every Branching Timeline, Every Parallel Universe...

Jacob's voice rises, and his words become a stream-of-consciousness monologue.

JACOB: (frantically) And What If I'm Not Just One Person? What If I'm Every Person? Every Decision, Every Choice, Every Outcome? What If I'm The Sum Total Of All Human Experience?

Jacob's eyes widen, and his face contorts in a mixture of fear and awe.

JACOB: (screaming) OH GOD, WHAT IF I'M THE QUANTUM SUPERPOSITION OF ALL HUMANITY?!

The room around Jacob begins to distort and blur, and he becomes lost in a sea of possibilities. His body begins to shake, and his voice rises to a fever pitch.

JACOB: (wailing) I'M EVERYONE! I'M EVERYTHING! I'M THE UNIVERSE ITSELF!

The camera zooms out, and we see Jacob's bedroom, now a swirling vortex of colors and lights. The sound of his screams echoes through the room, and the screen fades to black.

FADE OUT.
